items: **How your applications are going**, on the Dashboard: applications, interviews, offers, rejected or closed, no reply yet and no reply after 30 days, and the replies you record on an application (a viewed notice, a recruiter's call, a questionnaire).

**Review your rejections**, on My applications: what your newest rejections have in common, as a checklist (a resume a tracking system cannot read, skills asked for again and again, job titles never named), and their scores beside the applications that reached an interview.

**Edit what the AI wrote**: a tailored resume, a CV or a cover letter, in your own words; and **Your own words into resume edits** turns what you write about your work, with your figures, into edits to a tailored resume.

**Six more job boards**, remote jobs in every field: We Work Remotely, Jobicy, Remote OK, Remotive, Working Nomads and Dynamite Jobs. Every board is on unless you switch it off, and Job posts mixes posts from different boards.
**A fresh scan keeps the jobs you applied to**: **Run fresh scan** and **Delete all scanned posts** deleted them too. A tailored resume or cover letter now deletes in one click.

**Security**: the Docker image installs jobdork from a built wheel, and opentelemetry-api, used by the installer builds, is updated for a known vulnerability. The Linux desktop app can run in Docker for testing.
